Nora (People Ops): Quick micro-checklist for managers running Week 1 with new hires. Trying to keep it paste-ready for calendar invites. Please quick-review.

Nora (People Ops): Pre-day: IT ticket + access matrix, assign buddy (peer), send intro note with timezones. Day1 AM: 20m org context, 20m manager 1:1 (role purpose + success signals), 20m team intros. Day1 PM: accounts + tooling, security micro-brief. Day2: product + arch walkthrough. Day3: local dev + starter PR assigned. Day4: cross-team intros + draft 30/60/90. Day5: ship/pair on small change + feedback and 1-week sync.

Ben (Eng Manager): Looks good. Can you add a "first-PR" rubric (tests, lint, 1 reviewer) and a Day5 90-min deploy-shadow slot?

Nora (People Ops): Added both. First-PR rubric: unit test(s) or repro, lint green, 1 reviewer from squad, CI green or known flaky test note. Day5 deploy-shadow 90m added.

Iris (DevEx): I'll auto-label starter PRs as "onboard-starter" and drop a starter-issues list. Also recommend a 2-item manager 1:1 script: 1) top 3 priorities; 2) communication preferences + 1:1 cadence.

Omar (IT): Managers: file provisioning form ASAP (https://redwood.ok/it-newhire). Tickets before 10:00 PST on start day usually get same-day hardware and VPN. For KMS/HSM access include manager sign-off.

Kai (new-hire): Thanks! Quick: how big should Day3 PR be?

Ben (Eng Manager): Keep it tiny and meaningful: docs fix, single test, or small bug (1-3 files). We'll pair if you'd like.

OnboardBot: Week1 calendar created: 10:00-12:00 daily local. Manager, buddy, and new hire invited.

Nora (People Ops): Final ask: managers confirm buddy + IT ticket 48h before start. I'll publish the paste-ready card + editable 30/60/90 template to the drive by EOD. :sparkles:
